reason: This is a broad, cross-cutting planner-context refactor that touches core optimizer paths, cardinality/statistics estimation, range building, plan cache, point-get/partition pruning, and some executor/sessionctx plumbing. Even if intended as context plumbing, changing how planner-phase state is sourced and propagated across this many central files has real risk of optimizer semantic regressions, incorrect plan selection/caching, or runtime/planner context mismatches.
